circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: Kelley Brannon was at the Sunshine Inn in Live Oak Florida on july 14th 2020. She and her boy friend were traveling on I-75 on or about July 09th when they had vehicle trouble and were forced to stay  in Live Oak, awaiting vehicle repair. During the evening hours of July 14th, after an ongoing argument between the two,  Kelley left a voice mail stating that she was "getting in a car." The voice mail was left at 0059 hours on the 15th of July. Some witnesses at the hotel stated that Kelley was seen walking away from the hotel on US Highway 90 headed East. She was stated to have had her guitar in a case over her shoulder as she walked away. This was reportedly around the same time frame that she left the phone message. Kelley had her cell phone but left behind all other possessions including currency and identification. Security video from the hotel has been reviewed. Although several vehicles enter and depart the parking lot it is unknown if Kelley may have entered any of these vehicles. She has not been in contact with close friends or family members since that time, which has been described as not normal behavior for Kelley.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: Tina Donovan was reported missing from Ottawa, IL by her family after she did not show up for work. Tina also left a cryptic note and sent letters about leaving and referenced "eating from the tree of life." She was last seen on 01/13/2020 at 1345 hours withdrawing money from her bank account and using crutches to move around and wearing a black coat. Tina's phone was pinged and the last on location was in the area of Starved Rock State Park at 1723 hours.  Tina's vehicle was found parked unoccupied at the Starved Rock Lodge.  Video footage was obtained and a woman matching Tina's description was seen on video walking from the parking lot using her crutches, towards the trail entrance at the Park.  A ground search was conducted. Tina's crutches and personal belongings were located several days later at the bottom of a cliff in the Park, which is at the bank of the Illinois River.  Tina was believed to have gone into the Illinois River based on the steep terrain where her property was recovered. Tina is still missing from Ottawa and the case remains under investigation.

Aaron's truck was parked at this location near the intersection of Hwy CC and Hwy N.  Aaron's phone was pinged on 10/11/2020 at 10:15 hours to an area 12.6 miles NW of Ladysmith, WI.  On 12/03/2020, Aaron's vehicle was recovered on a remote logging road.  An extensive search of the area was conducted and numerous clothing items were recovered in various locations.  The clothing items are believed to be Aaron's including a pair of pants containing his identification.  

On 12/14 /2020, a citizen reported seeing a man matching Aaron's description walking down a road in the same vicinity where the clothes were located.   The person was observed on 10/12/2020 and was only wearing socks, boxer briefs and a tank top. The citizen asked the male if he needed help, and the male advised he was fine.  The citizen captured a photograph of the man as he walked away.  The citizen provided the image to investigators.  A family member later confirmed the man in the picture is Aaron.  He has not been seen or heard from since 10/12/2020.

01/29/21 Caldwell County SO release: 
The Caldwell County Sheriff’s Office continues the search for 21 year old, Jason Landry, who is considered a missing person. 
The Caldwell County Sheriff’s Office has been partnered with the Texas Rangers and a team of retired Federal Agents/ private investigators in attempting to locate Jason Landry who has been missing since Sunday Dec. 13th, 2020. The Caldwell County Sheriff’s Office has utilized and will continue to utilize assistance from other agencies, including the Caldwell County District Attorney’s Office, Texas State University Police, San Marcos Police Department, Texas Department of Public Safety, and TEXSAR- Texas Search and Rescue. 

We are asking the public’s assistance with any information which may further the investigation.
Investigators believe that Jason left his apartment in San Marcos at 10:55 PM on 12.13.20 with the intent to travel to the Missouri City Texas area.  

Jason’s vehicle was found abandoned, lights on, with the keys in the ignition, and the front passenger side door locked. The vehicle collision is a single vehicle collision.  The Sheriff’s Office and investigators will continue to aggressively seek out evidence in this missing person incident.  The Sheriff’s Office will continue to work with Texas Search and Rescue and other search organizations in an effort to discover any evidence of Jason’s location and additional searches are being planned and organized.

Golden Gate Bridge Patrol Officers advised they made contact with MP on 2/01/2021 two times during the day and identified the subject by name. At approximately 0305 hours on 02/02/2021, CHP Officers spotted a pedestrian in a black jacket and black pants walking northbound on the east sidewalk of the bridge. They notified Bridge Patrol , exited and turned back southbound to look for the pedestrian , but were unable to locate him. GGB Patrol Sgt. located video footage at 0305 hours of the pedestrian, a white male adult, climbing over the south east gate for the east sidewalk. He was observed walking northbound on the east sidewalk out of the camera's view. A marker was deployed at the pedestrian's last known location, and Coast Guard searched the area to no avail.  It is unknown if the pedestrian was in fact McChesney, or if he jumped.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Tiffany Nicole Foster was reported missing and had not been seen or heard from since March 1st, 2021.  She was last seen at Lakeside Apartments, Newnan, Ga. 

Tiffany Foster  was described by friends, family and coworkers as being dependable at her place of work with no issues. Foster does not have a history of failing to show up for work. Foster was scheduled to work as a security guard at Hello Fresh in Coweta County on March 5th, 2021 and she failed to report for her shift and had no contact with anyone at her job. 

Foster also has a social media account on Facebook which she is a regular user of making post on average 4-5 times a month. Since the time of her disappearance her social media account has gone silent last being used on February 28th, 2021. Foster has a cellular telephone that she regularly uses to communicate with her friends, family, and coworkers.  Since March 1, 2021 no one has been able to reach her via this phone nor has she contacted anyone via this phone.  The last time that the phone showed as active was March 1, 2021 at 14:58 just north of Amlajack Blvd. 

Foster’s Debit card, her only known financial transaction card, was not in her possession. 

Foster’s vehicle, a 2020 Nissan Altima, which had been recently purchased was discovered abandoned in College Park on March 8th, 2021 with some of her possessions inside.

The last time Mr. Johnson's cell phone pinged was on 11/22/2021 at 1717 hours off of Bald Head Island, NC.

On 6/21/2022, the Carolina Beach Police Department was contacted by authorities in São Jorge Island, Azores, Portugal in reference to locating Mr. Johnson's missing vessel. The condition of the vessel showed heavy barnacle and algae buildup indicative of the vessel having been capsized and/or on shore for an unknown extended period of time. The Portuguese authorities conducted an examination of the vessel and a search of the area and was unable to locate Mr. Johnson or obtain information on his whereabouts.

Osceola County Sheriff are searching for information from the public about the disappearance of Paola M. Miranda Rosa, 31 who was last seen at Wekiwa Springs State Park, specifically Otter Camp.

notes.description:
Paola M. Miranda Rosa was last seen at 3330 S. Semoran Boulevard, in Orlando, Florida and her family last heard from her the evening of December 17, 2021.

Paola M. Miranda Rosa was physically last seen by a camper at Wekiwa Springs State Park specifically, Otter Camp on December 18, 2021. Since then, there is no leads as to her whereabout.

Her vehicle was found at the Sand Lake Parking lot in Wekiwa Springs State Park. Her phone along with her wallet and personal belongings were left behind in the vehicle.

At this time, all search and rescue efforts within Wekiwa State Park have been exhausted and Paola M. Miranda Rosa was not found.

Authorities are urging anyone with ANY information or tip to please communicate it to Osceola County Sheriff Office at 407-348-2222 or 911 (Incident # 21I131583).

Mr. Dewey does not have or own a cell phone. He does have a landline. 
Mr. Dewey ws last seen by his neighbor on March 23, 2022, however, we located video footage of Mr. Dewey from Black Oak Baptist church t 6404 Old Maynardville Pk, Knoxville Tn 37918 on March 24, 2022 at approximately 2am. She was throwing up, had no shoes, she was unsteady on her feet and she was walking in and out of the roadway (VT RT 9). There have been numerous unconfirmed reports from citizens seeing someone matching Reid's description in Brattleboro VT.  She has yet to be successfully located.  Searches of the area have yielded no results. She has had no contact with her family since March 24th.  There are concerns for her welfare.  Mary has been known to hitchhike in the past.

notes.description:
Pasco Sheriff’s detectives continue to search for information regarding missing person, Alyssa Ciccarelli. At this point in the investigation, PSO does not believe that Ciccarelli is alive.

After Ciccarelli was reported missing on April 23, detectives were able to determine that Ciccarelli left the Holiday Hotel on April 17 and met with Scott Quinn, 39, for a drug transaction. Detectives spoke with Quinn who advised he saw Ciccarelli at Embassy Food & Gas in Port Richey on April 17, but parted ways after that. Detectives searched an area of Cherry Creek Ln. in Port Richey on May 10 after locating items that were believed to belong to Ciccarelli. This area is also close to where Quinn was staying around April 17. Nothing of significance was found during the search.

Detectives once again spoke with Quinn on May 10 and 11 and Quinn then told detectives that he and Ciccarelli used fentanyl together in the woods near the Cherry Creek Ln. area on April 17 and stated that Ciccarelli “nodded out.” Quinn then stole many of Ciccarelli’s belongings and left the area. Quinn returned to the area in the early morning hours of April 18 to discover Ciccarelli deceased, and did not attempt to contact Fire Rescue or law enforcement. Instead, he claimed he placed Ciccarelli inside a nearby dumpster, then discarded more of Ciccarelli’s belongings. Quinn also pawned some of Ciccarelli’s belongings that he stole after failing to render any aid to Ciccarelli.

Quinn is arrested on several charges relating to this case, including Tampering with Physical Evidence, False Verification of Ownership, Dealing in Stolen Property and False Information to Law Enforcement During a Missing Persons Investigation and Grand Theft. Quinn was already in the Land O’ Lakes Detention Center for charges unrelated to this case.

PSO continues to investigate this case to find Ciccarelli. Anyone with information should call the PSO Crime Tips Line at 1-800-706-2488 or report tips online at PascoSheriff.com/tips.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: On November 5th, 2022, a convenient store employee contacted law enforcement and stated that she was concerned about a store patron. The store employee stated that the store patron would come into the store everyday, without fail, to purchase coffee on his way to work. However, the individual had not been inside the store in several days. The convenient store employee identified the individual as Antolin Martinez Sanchez. Detective Spoke with Sanchez's Supervisor, who stated that Sanchez's last day was on September 16th, 2022, and after that Sanchez did not return to work. Sanchez's employer did state that Sanchez had recently been talking about having a child with his girlfriend. The employer believed the girlfriend was from Tennessee. Detective also spoke with Sanchez's roommate, who confirmed the story about the girlfriend from Tennessee and confirmed that Sanchez had had been talking about having a child with his girlfriend. Sanchez was last seen in the Tow of Sparta, at Carolina West, Paying his cell phone bill.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Christian Kath departed St. Petersburg, FL via airplane on 12/3/22 at approximately 16:42 and arrived at Venice Airport in Venice, FL at 17:15 the same date with his wife and daughter.  Christian Kath was the pilot of the aircraft. The family went to a local restaurant (Sharky's on the Pier) and then returned back to the Venice Airport at approximately 19:20 on 12/3/22 as evidenced by video collected in the investigation.  Christian Kath's airplane was observed via camera video footage taking off from the Venice Airport at approximately 19:37 on 12/3/22.  

On 12/4/22 at approximately 10:18, Venice Police Department was contacted by the Federal Aviation Administration requesting assistance in checking for Christian Kath's airplane at Venice Airport. Air traffic control in Tampa confirmed take off from the airfield on 12/3/22 at approximately 19:37 before losing contact.  The plane was due at Albert Whitted Airport in St. Petersburg, FL and did not arrive.   As this call for assistance was underway, Venice Fire Rescue (VFR), Venice Police Department (VPD), Florida Fish and Wildlife (FWC) and Sarasota County Sheriff's Office (SSO) marine units were responding to a water rescue/recovery of a deceased female found by a dive charter boat approximately 2 miles from the Venice shore.  At this location an aviation headset was also found in the water in proximity to the body. Based on this information a multi-agency search effort and investigation were initiated. The initial deceased female victim was recovered and transported to the VPD Marine Patrol Dock and received by the Medical Examiner's Office (ME) and later identified as the wife of Christian Kath.

At 14:11 on 12/3/22 a portion of the airplane wreckage was located approximately .3 miles off shore in 15 feet of water, spotted from the air by SSO helicopter unit Air 2.  Resources were directed to this location to focus recovery efforts.  The SSO SURF unit (dive team) arrived on scene and confirmed the partial wreckage of a plane at the location.  Notification was received that a second female victim was located, deceased, inside this portion of the plane and would later be identified as the daughter of Christian Kath. Exhaustive search efforts were taken to locate Christian Kath during the investigation however his person nor any remains relative to Christian Kath have been located.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: Kyle Garza was last seen in Port Huron, MI, early in the morning of September 16, 2023. LPR cameras indicated that the last tracking of Kyle's pickup truck occurred on Sept 16, 2023 at 1604 hours, near 8 Mile and Mound Roads, in Detroit.  On September 17th, 2023 at 0313 hrs, Kyle was recorded on security camera footage, pumping gas into the same pickup truck, at the Zoom gas station, located at 14545 Plymouth Road, Detroit.  This is the last known time that Kyle was observed, before his disappearance.  A cell phone ping of Kyle's phone indicates that it shut down on September 18th, 2023, with a ping location near 820 Pallester Street, Detroit.  On November 11th 2023, Kyle's pickup truck was located, parked in an apartment complex parking lot at 850 Whitmore Street, Detroit.  The vehicle was found to be in good condition, with Kyle's personal effects found intact, inside the vehicle.  No movement / activity has been noted regarding Kyle Garza since September 17th, 2023.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Gabriel "Gabe" Thor Crow was dropped off by his mother at Enterprise Car Rental (26 Tunnel Rd, Asheville, NC 28805) on January 25, 2024 to rent a vehicle. 

On January 27th, around 12:23 pm the Buncombe County Sheriffs Office located Gabe's rental car off in a field on Starnes Cove Rd, Asheville, NC 28806. All the doors were opened on the vehicle but no one was around. 

Gabe was located further down the road near Yosemite Trail. The Deputy spoke with Gabe about his car and asked what was going on with him. He stated that he was visiting a friend and found out things he did not like and did not want to be involved with them anymore. Gabe made the statement to the Deputy that he thought someone had put something in his car. 

The Deputy asked where the keys to the car were. Gabe told him that the friend he was visiting had thrown the keys in the field where the car was. Gabe told the Deputy that he was trying to get to a gas station. The Deputy pointed out the nearest gas station and offered him a ride, but Gabe declined and told the Deputy he was okay to just walk. The Deputy left the area as Gabe was walking down Starnes Cove Rd.

Gabe was reported missing by his family on January 28, 2024.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: According to video surveillance:  On 5/25/2024 at 0557 hours, Edward Fredrickson parked his vehicle in a gravel parking lot near 200 N. Ross Street in the Empire area of Coos Bay.  Mr. Fredrickson exited his vehicle alone, walked around a fence, and headed out across an open grassy field owned by Sause Bros.  He walked in a northerly direction towards the water's edge/shoreline at low tide.  (At this point, Mr. Fredrickson disappeared from camera view)  It is likely that Mr. Fredrickson walked the shoreline in a north-easterly direction towards the North Bend Airport.  It is unknown what happened once he got to the shoreline.  Search and Rescue covered the ground in the area along with Coast Guard fly-overs and boat patrols.  It is feared that Mr. Fredrickson went into the water.

notes.description: His vehicle was processed by the police department and recovered by his family.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: Steven was last known to be unhoused living in the San Bernardino Park area. He was in contact with family for a while and was being taken care of by two members of the public who would bring food and minor necessities to the transient population in the park. Family spoke with Steven and it was agreed that he would travel to where they lived in Kennewick, WA and they would make arrangements to get him into a local shelter. A plan was made that Steven was to take an AMTRAK train from San Bernardino to Pasco and family would meet him on the track when he arrived. The last they spoke with him they understood that the two individuals who previously helped Steven had made arrangements to drive Steven to the train station and provided him with either a ticket or the funds for a ticket for the train to Pasco, WA.  However, Steven did not get off the train when it arrived to Pasco, WA and family is unsure if Steven ever got on the train in San Bernardino.

notes.description: Was supposed to be on Amtrak train to Pasco, Washington where he never arrived.  Never saw him again.

The vehicle that Costello was driving was located in the Sagamore Park and Ride at the base of the Sagamore Bridge. After speaking with Costello's parents, and viewing footage from the Sagamore Bridge, the male seen jumping was wearing similar clothing Costello was seen wearing by his parents that morning, matched Costello's demographics and physical description. Costello had a "buzz cut" style haircut and had no tattoos. The male who jumped from the Sagamore Bridge on video can be seen wearing light grey sweatpants and a dark colored sweatshirt with a light-colored logo on the back.

On 02/10/22, at approximately 1000 hrs., Kevin J. Richter left his home near Joyce, WA after telling his girlfriend whom he lived with that he was going on a bike ride. Richter departed on a mountain bike that he owned and was last seen wearing a camouflaged sweatshirt and Carhartt jeans. The girlfriend believes that Richter also took a .45 caliber pistol that he owned with him, as she was unable to locate the pistol when she searched the home later in the day. Richter did not return from the bike ride and was reported missing at approximately 1700 hrs. on 02/10/22. 

On 02-11-22 at about 1051 hours, using cellular phone location information, Richter’s bicycle and cellular phone were found off of a hiking path located in a forested area between Crescent Beach Rd. and Hwy 112/Dawley Rd. (about 2.5 miles from his home). Analysis of the data on Richter’s recovered cellular phone revealed that he had been researching topics on how to survive in remote areas and the best places to disappear in. Richter has not been seen or heard from since his disappearance nearly three years ago.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: Victor was last seen by his live in girlfriend at their residence at 116 W F St in Turlock on July 26, 2023.  He was captured on video surveillance leaving the property in his black 2011 Lincoln MKZ bearing California license plate 9BWN399.  License plate reader (LPR) cameras in Livingston, California, Merced County captured Victor's vehicle coming and going in and around the city from July 16, 2023 through July 27, 2023.  The reporting party (RP) had access to track two (2) Apple AirTags Victor had activated.  One of the AirTags attached to his keys last pinged in Merced County on July 27, 2023.  The other attached to his cell phone last pinged at a truck stop in Kingman Arizona on July 28, 2023.  A friend of Victor's shared a cell phone video of Victor's vehicle parked, unoccupied, with the windows down on what appeared to be a rural property, taken sometime between July 26th and July 28th.  This property was later identified and located in Merced County.  On August 3, 2023 Victor's vehicle was located in an orchard on W Dickenson Ferry Rd in Merced, California, Merced County.  The vehicle had been set on fire and had little remaining evidence.  It was determined there were no human remains inside of the vehicle at the time of the fire.

vehicles.comment: Vehicle recovered burned.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Jonathan Hoang went missing in Arlington, WA. He was last seen in his home on his way to bed Sunday, March 30th at 7:30 PM. He left the home without telling anyone and with only his iPad - without his jacket or shoes, wallet, or phone - all huge deviations from his typical behavior. 

Snohomish County Sheriff utilized SAR, professional trackers, scent dogs from multiple counties, drones, helicopters with infrared cameras, technology specialist to look at Jonathan's devices.. The final SAR took place on Saturday, April 5th, and the Snohomish County Sheriff has passed the case on to Major Crimes with no leads. 

The family believes he was taken by car.

Although he is verbal, he may not have the skills to seek help, he struggles with problem-solving and tends to shut down when presented with a stressful situation or problem he doesn’t know how to address. If lost, he likely doesn’t know to put himself in a visible space for searchers. He will not be able to relay his own address or phone numbers. Stims: When anxious, he often rocks or paces. With high anxiety or stress, his movements can become stiff as he paces. Occasionally he has a vocal stim that sounds a bit like “hmm.” He often sits with his shoulders hunched forward.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Robert Clay, 77, was last seen by family at about 10:00 PM on Monday, June 23rd. A credible sighting of Clay, on Glebe Road, occurred around 6:30 AM on Tuesday, June 24th. It is possible that Clay may have been seen walking north on Glebe Road, a short distance from his residence. Clay has not been seen since. This area is in close proximity to NH Rt. 9 and the town of Westmoreland. It is believed that Clay left his home wearing white Nike sneakers, blue jeans, and possibly a long sleeve denim shirt. Mr. Clay has gray hair, green eyes, is 5 foot 7 inches, 140 lbs., and walks with a hunch. 

Search crews have scoured the forests, roads, and waters surrounding Clay’s home. Along with searchers on foot, K9 teams, drones, ATVs, and a helicopter were utilized. Members of NH Fish and Game, NH State Police, MA State Police Air Wing Unit, Chesterfield Police, Spofford Fire Department, Keene Fire Department, Swanzey Fire Department, Gilford VT Fire Department, Putney VT Fire Department, Rescue Inc., Upper Valley Wilderness Response Team, NH National Guard Volunteer Search and Rescue Team, New England K9 Search and Rescue, North Country Search Dogs, and members of the community have all assisted in the search effort.

notes.description: Clay has late-stage dementia and has been located walking roads in the area in the recent past.

clothingAndAccessoriesArticles.description: It is believed that Clay left his home wearing white Nike sneakers, blue jeans, and possibly a long sleeve denim shirt.

On June 20, 2025, at approximately 1730 hours, the Sheriff's Office received a report regarding a missing 75-year-old male. The reporting party, a family member, advised that the missing person (MP) had contacted them via phone later that evening at approximately 2200 hours, and reported he was near a road marker labeled “7.6.32.1.”

Deputies responded promptly and located the referenced road marker within a few hours. However, the MP was no longer present at that location when law enforcement arrived.

Investigative data showed that the MP’s cell phone last pinged on June 20, 2025, at approximately 2000 hours near GPS coordinates 44.92095, -123.43023, placing the device within an approximate 1000-meter radius of that location.

Additional information was obtained from HUM vehicle telemetry data associated with the MP’s vehicle, a 1999 white Toyota 4Runner bearing Oregon license plate 946DFC. Data indicated that the MP arrived in the Rickreall Creek area at approximately 1400 hours. The vehicle was subsequently tracked driving toward the Mercer Reservoir before turning around at what appeared to be an impassable section of roadway. The MP then returned to a gate that was reportedly open earlier in the day but now believed to have been closed, arriving back in that area shortly after 1630 hours.

Vehicle trip data further revealed multiple additional movements north and northwest along Burma Road (also referred to as 1920 Road), each time returning to the vicinity of the closed gate. The final telemetry record showed the vehicle at or near the gate location at approximately 2000 hours on June 20th, corresponding with the last known cell phone ping.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Jennifer was reportedly last seen in the area of Ponderosa Rd. off of VOA Rd. in Washington, NC at approximately 6:30am on Friday, June 27th, 2025. She was not reported missing until Sunday, June 29th, 2025. It is unknown if Jennifer walked away from the area on her own or left with another individual. 

It was reported that Jennifer was last seen wearing a teal in color shirt, possibly displaying the words "Simply Southern", and wearing black leggings. Jennifer possibly had a green in color backpack and black handbag/purse with her at the time of disappearance. In a surveillance photo captured approximately 7hrs before Jennifer's disappearance, she is seen wearing a long gray in color sun dress with a knot tied in it on the front bottom left and wearing brown open toed sandals. She is also seen carrying what appears to be a white in color wallet. 

There is currently a $5,000 reward for information that leads to locating Jennifer Watkins. Information can be submitted anonymously at www.p3tips.com/195 or by calling (252) 974-6400.

On 7/26/2024 at approximately 1100 hours, a family member saw Pierre at the Consulate General of Haiti of Orlando attempting to renew his Haitian passport. The family member contacted another family member by phone about Pierre, as he was acting abnormal and trying to leave the location in a Mears taxicab. The family members were advising the cab driver to take Pierre to the hospital and the driver agreed. The driver advised that Pierre paid $400 to be taken to Fort Lauderdale, FL. The driver allegedly took Pierre to a hospital, but Pierre refused to leave the taxicab. The driver took Pierre to the Orlando International Airport instead and dropped him off at an unknown location at possibly 1140 hours. It is unknown at this time if the driver or Pierre suggested the airport.

Family have not physically seen Pierre since 7/24/2024 around 1400 hours. On 7/22/2024, Pierre abruptly quit his two jobs and made statements that he wanted to go to Haiti. On 7/31/2024, family received a letter that was addressed to Pierre from the airport’s lost and found. The letter advised there were two pieces of luggage belonging to Pierre found on property. circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Ellen Ruth DOMB was last seen on December 5, 2025, while participating in a recreational scuba dive on the USNS Vandenberg wreck offshore Key West, Monroe County, Florida. DOMB entered the water from the private vessel Activated Eau and became separated from her dive partner within minutes of descent due to strong current conditions. Her dive partner was recovered by a nearby dive vessel; however, DOMB continued her descent alone and failed to resurface as planned.

At the time of her disappearance, DOMB was wearing standard scuba diving equipment, including a TUSA Liberator Sigma II buoyancy compensator jacket (BCJ), Model BC0101M / BC0101B, Serial Number K0510010. She was also wearing a 14-pound weight belt and yellow/green fins. An aluminum 80-cubic-foot scuba tank was used for the dive.

Extensive multi-day search and rescue operations were conducted by the United States Coast Guard and assisting agencies utilizing surface, subsurface, and aerial assets.  DOMB has not been located.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance:
Mr. Palmer began a road trip from his home in Missouri on or about 12/14/2025.  On 01/09/2026, the family of Mr. Palmer lost cell phone contact with him.  On 01/12/2026, Cape Hatteras National Seashore Park Rangers found Palmer's truck parked and un-occupied on the beach near the shoreline.  The truck was impounded. On 01/18/2026 the tow truck company advised that the truck had not been claimed, and an investigation began.  When Mr. Palmer's father was contacted; he advised that he could not reach his son.  

A ground search in the area found no clues as to where Mr. Palmer was.  Due to the timeframe of the truck being found and the investigation / search commencing, a large-scale water search was not initiated.  

During the investigation it was learned that Mr. Palmer had a blue and white white-water kayak with him and a 10-year-old German Sheppard dog named "Zoey."  Neither the Kayak nor the dog have been located either.  A local resident did find a kayak skirt and strap on the beach that the family of Mr. Palmer have identified as the same color and brand that Mr. palmer used.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: On 03/17/25 the juvenile was reporting missing after she did not show up for school.  A video showed a female walking towards Van Wagner Road at 5:46am, wearing dark clothing, white sneakers and carrying an umbrella. A family member observed the video and believed the female to be Maya. On 03/17/25, at 7:33am, the City of Poughkeepsie Police Department received a call of a person possibly jumping off the Walkway over the Hudson Bridge. A witness stated that he had been talking to a female when he turned around for a second. When the witness turned back towards the female she was no longer standing on the bridge and he believed she jumped. Recovery efforts to locate a body in the Hudson River were negative. A red umbrella was located on the bridge where the female had been standing. An image of the female from the bridge was shown to a family member but they were unable to say for sure if it was Maya. The clothing description from the witness was similar to what Maya had been observed on camera wearing that day.  As of today, 02/13/26, a body has not been recovered. There have been no investigate leads to indicate that Maya is still alive.

circumstances.circumstancesOfDisappearance: On November 23, 2025, Lonie Davis was sleeping in a 16-foot open motorboat, tied up to one of his two sailboats and anchored in the Columbia River, near the mouth of the Skipanon River, near Warrenton, OR. Around 4 a.m., he called his girlfriend and reported his anchor line broke and he was drifting west, toward the Columbia River bar. About 45 minutes later, he told her his boat had capsized and he was in the water. His phone went dead. The U.S. Coast Guard searched the area by boat and helicopter. The Coast Guard located the motorboat near Cape Disappointment, WA. The Clatsop County Sheriff's Office has conducted searches by boat and airplane.

The subject went missing on 12-07-2025 in Buffalo Grove. His vehicle was located in Winthrop Harbor, Illinois, at Northpoint Marina. The vehicle was located and unoccupied. The vehicle was locked. The missing person was unable to be located, and neither was his cellphone or wallet. Multiple searches by K9, Drone, and personnel were conducted with negative results.  No note, no credit card usage, and no contact with family, girlfriend, or friends.

On the morning of July 9, 2023, Ogata-Staudinger was reportedly picking opihi with a relative in the area of Kahakai Boulevard and Papio Street in Pāhoa, at a spot commonly known as “Hau Bush.” Ogata-Staudinger became separated from her relative and failed to return to their prearranged meeting spot later that day. She has not been seen or heard from by her family since.

Emergency personnel conducted an extensive area search, including police with a scent discriminating canine, the Hawai‘i Fire Department’s helicopter, and the United States Coast Guard; however, Ogata-Staudinger was not located.

Police have continued to follow up on tips and have interviewed many known associates, friends, and family of Ogata-Staudinger.  

Ogata-Staudinger is described as local with a medium build, 5 feet 2 inches tall, 150 pounds, with brown hair and hazel eyes. She has a dollar sign symbol tattoo on her left cheek.

Quang Than, a 66-year-old male from Huntington Beach, CA, separated from his hiking group at the base of the ascent to Split Mountain. Than waited at the bottom of the approach to the summit (coordinates for approximate point last seen: 37.025776°, -118.422293°) while his two hiking partners attempted the summit. Than was visible to his hiking partners most of the way to the summit, although they lost sight of him for about 20 minutes. One hiking partner observed Than stand up and begin wandering down in the direction of the Tinemaha Creek drainage. Upon returning Than's last known location, his hiking group could not find him. Than's hiking party were unable to locate any sign of him on their return hike. Than's gear cache was untouched near Red Lake. An exhaustive multi-agency search including Sequoia and Kings Canyon National Park and Inyo County could not locate and signs of Than.

At 1933 hours, the friend's father got a text message from the friend stating that another family member of Tyla was picking the girls up and they would be home soon. The friend's parents reported that the phone has been turned off and have had no contact with her since. The girls can be seen leaving Garden State Plaza at 1740 hours and getting on a bus which provides shuttle service to Paterson, NJ.

Deputies conducted a brief search of the area and repeatedly called out for Mr. Bruce; however, he did not respond, and they were unable to locate him.
The following week, Mr. Bruce's family reported that they had been unable to locate him. A subsequent search was conducted utilizing law enforcement personnel, a drone, and a K-9 unit. Despite these efforts, no signs of Mr. Bruce were located.

She was tracked to two locations in Cincinnati and was actually captured on the porch of one of the homes by the Google Street View vehicle. Juana appears to still be in Cincinnati.

On July 22nd, 2026, Neah Bay Public Safety contacted Clallam County Sheriff’s Office with information regarding an individual unaccounted for at the Cape Flattery trailhead located on Makah Tribal Land. Deputies investigated and learned 53-year-old Jeffrey R. Hunter from Columbus, Ohio had parked his vehicle on July 16th at the Cape Flattery parking area and had not returned. No one had seen or heard from Hunter since he obtained his Makah permit to be on tribal land. Deputies contacted Hunter’s family and learned Hunter had been on a road trip, and no one had heard from him in several days.  On July 23rd, 2026, Deputies initiated a multi-agency response to attempt to locate Hunter. On July 24, 2026, the Clallam County Sheriff's Office Search and Rescue operation for Hunter at Cape Flattery concluded. Over the course of the multi-day operation, search teams conducted an exhaustive search of the entire Cape Flattery trail system, including the beaches, coves, ravines, and surrounding terrain. Despite the extensive efforts of ground search teams, technical rescue personnel, K9 teams, marine resources, and aviation support, Jeffrey R. Hunter was not located. The search concluded with no sightings of Hunter and no new leads to continue investigative search efforts. The Clallam County Sheriff's Office asks anyone who may have information regarding the whereabouts of Jeffrey R. Hunter to contact Clallam County Dispatch.
